body: The 2026 edition supersedes the 2024 (v2.0) list. Prompt injection stays at number one, excessive agency rises to number three, and the ranking now weights about 7,700 real-world incidents against the community vote. Published by the OWASP GenAI Security Project on 4 August 2026.

The Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) left the text of Article 50 unchanged but added a transitional period: systems already on the market before 2 August 2026 have until 2 December 2026 to meet the Article 50(2) machine-readable marking obligation.

SB 26-189 repeals the earlier SB 24-205 and replaces it with a consequential-decision disclosure regime, effective 1 January 2027. A federal court had blocked enforcement of SB 24-205 in April 2026 (xAI v. Weiser) before the replacement was signed.
The Fed, OCC, and FDIC jointly superseded SR 11-7 with SR 26-2 (OCC 2026-13). Generative and agentic AI are held out of scope pending a future request for information.
Chapter amendments align the Act with California SB 53 and create a NYDFS oversight office. Signed December 2025, effective 1 January 2027.
SB 149 has been amended in each subsequent session by SB 226, SB 271, SB 332, and HB 452.
